look_review: Fresh review of every exact native cell at 192x208, plus actual look-directions.png. Clockwise sequence travels from raised beak/chin UP through exposed RIGHT, progressive head bow to visible DOWN face, then bowed LEFT and exposed LEFT to raised UP-LEFT and back to UP. All eight row10 cells, including 180, visibly retain green irises with dark pupils and white highlights. Head size stays within the standard identity family. Torso, folded wings, left tail and planted gold talons preserve the resting scaffold; the head/neck drive the gaze. 022.5 and 045 are close to UP and 247.5 is closer to a neutral-left pitch than a strong downward pitch; these are minor intermediate distinctions within the correct ordered arc. Cardinals are unambiguous.

Broad black openings at approximately x54-93,y83-148 lie between curved tail and wing/neck silhouettes; the lower x105-124,y165-185 opening lies between separated legs/talons.
